issues.description: Comment claims the old finance-workspace-sync local-plan patch is '逐字一致' (byte-identical) with adcda94b. At whole-file level run_review_sync.py differs (PLANS/resolve_plan refactored into market_feature_store/consumption_registry.py on main). limitations: Bounded offline review: no real install against the live HOME, no loaded launchd value (launchctl print) verification, no live sync, no collector/provider/API calls.

Author documentary evidence (docs/, verification logs, handoff claims) not inspected per contract; conclusions derived from code, plist semantics, on-disk roots, and independent execution with fake HOME + stub launchctl.

Operator release conditions (jobs idle, lock absent, hash preflight, backups, explicit rollback, post-release loaded-value checks) assessed as sufficient but not performed; installer intentionally provides no two-job transaction or auto-rollback, leaving a bounded mixed-state risk on mid-install failure that rerun + backups cover.
Data recovery, supplier completeness, and real 18:30/20:40 night-run acceptance are not signed by this review.
